kind: analyze (conventional diffuse-mismatch transmission across the Si/Ge interface from tabulated bulk spectra; window means and the bandwidth over which the wave-based reference exceeds it)
provenance: 3_reproduction/L5/result.json key primary_metrics (commit af1723c, reviewer human audit 2026-09-06), re-derived on the staged tables by reviewer/make_reference_submission.py on 2026-09-10; every graded value equals the record to the last digit (relative difference 0). Tolerances: result.json key proposed_relative_grading_tolerance (0.1).

mean_T_dmm_0p5_4p5THz.rule: +/-10 percent relative (scalar rule 2(1)); trapezoid mean of the Si-incident DMM transmission over 0.5-4.5 THz

agf_above_dmm_bandwidth_THz.rule: +/-10 percent relative. A physical interval length (the frequency measure of AGF > DMM within 0.5-7.5 THz, piecewise-linear crossings), graded two-sided; it is not an agreement-error metric, so the one-sided rule 2(3) does not apply

not_graded.T_dmm_curve: the per-frequency DMM transmission enters only through the three means and the bandwidth
not_graded.apparent_cutoffs: the 1%-of-own-peak cutoff offset between the two curves is a recorded comparison of the leaf, not a graded value
not_graded.reverse_direction: the Ge-incident transmission is the complement of the model and is not requested

score: 1 only if every primary check passes (binary all-primary-pass)
